caption: The drawing depicts a single, flat, stylized shape resembling a rooster or chicken in profile, with simplified curves for the body, tail, neck, head, comb, and beak. The figure is colored with a distressed or weathered reddish-brown paint, showing significant areas where the paint has worn away to reveal a lighter, beige or wood color underneath. The shape has smooth, rounded contours and is placed centrally on a plain, off-white or light beige background with no additional objects or patterns. The image appears two-dimensional, and there are no visible outlines or shading aside from the texture of the worn paint.
title: Wooden Weather Vane
